types.label: Pole Board / Pole Kiosk
types.hint: Boards on lamp poles, usually along the centre divider

types.label: Hoarding / Billboard
types.hint: Standard large-format hoarding on a structure

types.label: Unipole
types.hint: Single-pole elevated hoarding, often at junctions and highways

types.label: Gantry
types.hint: Spans the full width of the road

types.label: Median / Divider Board
types.hint: Low boards mounted on the road median itself

types.label: Traffic / Police Booth
types.hint: Branding panels on traffic-police booths and signals

types.label: Foot Over Bridge (FOB)
types.hint: Panels on pedestrian bridges

types.label: Flyover / Bridge Panel
types.hint: Panels on flyover pillars or bridge walls

types.label: Building Hoarding (Facade)
types.hint: Hoarding fixed on a building front

types.label: Rooftop Hoarding
types.hint: Structure on top of a building

types.label: Building Wrap / Mesh
types.hint: Full or partial facade wrap

types.label: Wall Painting / Wall Wrap
types.hint: Painted or vinyl-wrapped wall

types.label: Shop Board / Cantilever
types.hint: Shop fascia, glow sign or cantilever

types.label: Digital LED Screen
types.hint: Outdoor LED/LCD screen that plays a loop of ads

types.label: Indoor Digital Screen
types.hint: Screens in malls, lobbies, lifts and cafés

types.label: Mobile LED Van
types.hint: Vehicle-mounted screen; pin its usual base or route start

types.label: Bus Shelter
types.hint: Panels on bus-stop shelters

types.label: Bus / Auto Branding
types.hint: Vehicle wraps; pin the depot

types.label: Metro / Railway Station
types.hint: Station panels, pillars and platforms

types.label: Airport
types.hint: Terminal, arrival and baggage-belt media

types.label: Mall Branding
types.hint: Atrium drops, escalator panels, standees

types.label: Kiosk / Standee
types.hint: Freestanding kiosks and standees

types.label: Cinema
types.hint: On-screen slots and lobby branding

types.label: Other
types.hint: Anything that does not fit above
